source: GTA Wiki · GTABase.com · community benchmarks · 2024 patches
note: All costs in GTA$. net_profit_per_hr accounts for resupply costs where applicable. break_even_hrs = total_setup_cost / net_profit_per_hr. Active = requires active play; Semi-passive = periodic resupply (can AFK); Passive = earns offline.

businesses.name: Cayo Perico Heist
businesses.notes: Best solo money maker in the game. Primary loot matters — Panther Statue ($2.09M) vs cash ($~900k). Cooldown 1hr normal, 2.5hr first-time.
tips: Always check primary target before starting — Panther Statue/Madrazo Files are best
Complete Scoped Out prep free-roam before launch
Solo elite target: Pink Diamond or Panther Statue only
Use Aggressor loadout for speed

businesses.name: Acid Lab
businesses.prerequisite: Complete First Dose missions (free), buy lab upgrade
businesses.setup_cost_notes: Lab equipment upgrade $750k. Full upgrade (equipment + staff) ~$2.95M
businesses.resupply_notes: Requires active resupply every ~2.5hrs or buy supplies for $75k
businesses.notes: Best business $/hr after Cayo Perico. No MC needed if you complete First Dose. Sells at $330k per batch (fully upgraded).
tips: Complete First Dose mission series first (unlocks lab free of MC requirement)
Always upgrade equipment first — biggest $/hr boost
Sell in public lobby for 10% bonus
Pair with Nightclub tech for passive acid production

businesses.name: Nightclub
businesses.prerequisite: Own at least 1 other business to assign technicians
businesses.setup_cost_notes: Club $1.1-1.7M + equipment $1.4M + staff $0.3M + security $0.2M. Linked businesses (bunker/MC) add significant cost.
businesses.passive_notes: Earns while offline. Technicians accumulate stock passively linked to your other businesses.
businesses.notes: Only truly passive income in GTA Online. Technicians accumulate stock from linked businesses (bunker, MC labs, etc.) without resupply. Sell at $500-700k per full cycle.
tips: Assign technicians to: Cargo/Shipments, Sporting Goods (Bunker), Pharmaceutical Research (Cocaine)
Do NOT sell until nightclub is nearly full — maximize per-trip value
Nightclub popularity affects door entry income (minor) — play a DJ set occasionally
Link Acid Lab tech for best passive accumulation rate

businesses.name: Gunrunning Bunker
businesses.prerequisite: MOC (Mobile Operations Center) optional but recommended
businesses.setup_cost_notes: Cheapest bunker $1.165M + staff $0.26M + equipment $1.155M + security $0.11M + MOC optional $1.2M
businesses.passive_notes: Research/Manufacturing continues offline when resupplied. Check every 2.5hrs.
businesses.notes: Doubles as research facility unlocking weapon mods for free. Manufacturing sells at $700k+ (5 supplies). Resupply active or buy at $75k per 3 bars.
tips: Buy supplies rather than steal for efficiency when bunker is upgraded
Sell bunker stock solo (1 van) to avoid losing product
Complete research before switching to manufacturing — free weapon mods save millions
Paleto Bay bunker is cheapest but sells near city are easier

businesses.name: Vehicle Warehouse (CEO)
businesses.notes: Top-range export only method. Buy 32 cars minimum, fill with mid/standard, export only top-range ($100k each). Requires active play but no resupply.
tips: Only source and export top-range vehicles — ignore standard/mid when full
Fill warehouse with 1 standard + 1 mid + fill rest with top-range
Export in public lobby for 20% bonus
Have a bodyguard to protect exports for full profit

businesses.name: Diamond Casino Heist
businesses.setup_cost_notes: Cheapest arcade $1.235M + optional equipment upgrades + crew cuts
businesses.notes: Diamonds ($3.62M) or gold ($2.5M) as target. Player cut after crew is ~$1.1M each (2 players). Best target cycles every 2 weeks.
tips: Diamonds pay $3.62M max — check vault contents before finalising
Big Con + Gruppe Sechs/Noose disguise = easiest completion
Use cheap crew (Paige Harris as hacker, Karl Abolaji as gunman)
Always do Duggan Shipments prep for maximum vault time

businesses.name: Auto Shop (Contracts)
businesses.notes: Union Depository contract pays $180k solo. Pair with regular car deliveries ($20-80k each) for consistent income.
tips: Prioritize Union Depository contract — highest payout
Complete all 6 contracts for a loyalty bonus
Car delivery work fills gaps between contracts

businesses.name: Smuggler Hangar
businesses.notes: Slower than Bunker but no active resupply missions needed (can pay). Best paired with Nightclub technician.
tips: Steal cargo missions rather than buying — better margins
Sell at 50 units minimum for best price per unit
Assign Nightclub tech to Sporting Goods if you also own Bunker

businesses.name: Cocaine Lockup (MC)
businesses.passive_notes: Produces offline when resupplied. Best MC business by $/hr.
businesses.notes: Best MC business. Primarily valuable as Nightclub tech source. Standalone $/hr is poor — pair with Nightclub.
tips: Only worth running standalone if paired with Nightclub
Buy supplies (never steal) when upgraded — time-efficient
Sell solo in multiple trips to avoid losing product in public lobby

businesses.name: CEO Crates (Large Warehouse)
businesses.dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony (Jun 2016)
businesses.setup_cost_notes: Office ~$1M + large warehouse $3.5M + crate cost ~$2.4M to fill 111 crates
businesses.notes: Highest per-crate profit when selling 111 crates (~$2.2M sale) but brutal solo. Best in groups of 2-3 for speed. Risk of session being griefed is high.
tips: Never sell solo at 111 crates — too many delivery vehicles
Sell at 111 crates only with 2+ trusted players
Buy 3 at a time (3-crate missions) to reduce risk exposure
Consider CEO crates only if you enjoy the gameplay loop

businesses.name: VIP / CEO Work
businesses.dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony (Jun 2016)
businesses.prerequisite: CEO status (free after Maze Bank Foreclosures)
businesses.notes: No setup cost. Headhunter ($20k, 10min) is the classic farm. Hostile Takeover and Sightseer also efficient. Cooldown 5min between jobs.
tips: Headhunter is fastest — spawn in Maze Bank area for quick target kills
Stack with Nightclub / passive businesses running in background
Use during cooldowns between heist preps

businesses.name: Methamphetamine Lab (MC)
businesses.notes: Second best MC business. Low standalone value — best use is Nightclub technician source.

businesses.name: Weed Farm (MC)
businesses.notes: Low $/hr standalone. Only useful as Nightclub tech source (Organic Produce).

businesses.name: Counterfeit Cash Factory (MC)
businesses.notes: Low standalone. Nightclub tech source (Printing & Copying).

businesses.name: Document Forgery Office (MC)
businesses.notes: Worst MC business by $/hr. Only purpose: Nightclub tech source (Cargo & Shipments slot 2).
